help.title: Routine variables
help.description: How to prompt for inputs and which variables Paperclip fills in automatically.
help.customBodyBefore: anywhere in the title or instructions. Paperclip detects each placeholder, lists it under
help.customBodyAfter: , and prompts for a value before each run.
help.rule1: Names must start with a letter and may use letters, numbers, and underscores.
help.rule2: Pick a type (text, textarea, number, boolean, select, date), default value, and whether it is required.
help.rule3: Variable names ending in capital Date, such as startDate, are created as date variables by default.
help.rule4: The same name reused across the title and instructions is treated as one variable.
help.builtinBody: These are filled in automatically — no setup needed and they will not appear in the Variables list.
